subject.title: Long streaming model responses cause event loop starvation

question: Should #89392 stay open until current-main long-output Gateway stress proof demonstrates responsiveness, or is the existing #82545 cooperative-yielding work sufficient to close it?
rationale: The code contains plausible mitigations, but the issue's reported failure is a live Gateway-wide starvation path and the existing proof does not cover that exact workload.

options.title: Keep Open For Stress Proof
options.body: Require current-main DeepSeek or synthetic OpenAI-compatible Gateway proof before closing or scoping a new fix.

options.title: Close As Mitigated
options.body: Treat PR #82545 and current Gateway throttling as sufficient and close without a fresh long-output proof.

options.title: Scope Targeted Repair Now
options.body: Pick a suspected hotspot such as stream parsing, chat projection, or package runtime streaming and request a focused patch before live proof.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Stress Proof
recommendation.body: Require current-main DeepSeek or synthetic OpenAI-compatible Gateway proof before closing or scoping a new fix.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the merged cooperative-yielding fix and is the clearest owner for deciding whether that proof covers this broader report.
